summary.text: Brian Gray is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Ricki Ruiz; Ballotpedia lists his profession as clerk.

paragraphs.text: Gray served in the U.S. Army from 1972 to 1973, according to Ballotpedia.
He graduated from Anaheim High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Irvine in 1974.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Gray said he would seek to protect the proper use of taxpayer funds, represent all citizens of the district regardless of party, and protect the welfare of families, and he named fiscal policy as the area he is most passionate about.
